title: Activity gets a closer look
summary:
A busy day for things you can inspect and reuse: clearer Pollen activity, retrievable generated files, two image models, and sturdier routing.

A community contribution replaced Pollen summary cards with breakdown tables for usage by model and earnings by source. Follow-up work gave Usage and Earnings independent date navigation, filters, and metrics; chart bars can now filter the tables by click or keyboard. CSV exports keep each section’s date range, and recent events are easier to scan.

Generated image, video, audio, and 3D files now use Media storage, with stored-file responses pointing to a URL that can be fetched without generating again. Image generation and editing also accept `response_format: "url"`, including for community image models. Read-through recovery can bring matching files from the old cache into Media instead of regenerating or charging again. The docs now spell out these response options and existing Media upload-ID behavior.

Added paid-only `openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` for generation and reference-image edits with up to 16 input images. Multipart edits now pass through the requested size and output format, and transparent output keeps its PNG alpha. The model IDs were added to the image API docs.

daily.title: Explore Pollen activity
daily.text: See usage by model and earnings by source, with Paid and Quest Pollen shown separately. Navigate Usage and Earnings independently, then select a chart bar to filter its table.

daily.title: Get generated image URLs
daily.text: Use `response_format: "url"` for image generation or editing, including community image models. The returned Media URL retrieves the stored file without generating it again. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
